description: Train your brain. It’s all a mind game #selflove #maturity #selfleadership
transcript: Everything that we do is essentially a mind game. I am flexible throughout every season. I know that I have to readjust my internal world to what's happening in the external world. For me, I turn my brain off June to early August, and I allow myself to just explore and experience and move along. As soon as fall hits, that is my time to reset and get back into the momentum. You get to choose how you distribute information. Sometimes that looks like removing, sometimes that looks like filtering through, sometimes that looks like saving information for later.
